disease_state: inferred: D. acetexigens cultures grown with fumarate as the soluble electron acceptor were used as a control for the differential proteomic analyses.
material_type: The biofilm electrodes were collected with sterilized scissors in the anaerobic chamber for proteomic analysis.
sample_source: D. acetexigens cultures were incubated in triplicate in septa-sealed anaerobic vials containing 45 ml of growth medium
species: Differential protein expression levels were evaluated by comparing D. acetexigens cultures incubated with iron oxide minerals (i.e. hematite, goethite, magnetite) and D. acetexigens biofilm on the electrode of MECs, against cultures grown with a soluble electron acceptor (i.e. fumarate).
strain: D. acetexigens strain 2873 (DSM 1397) was obtained from the German collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures (DSMZ, Germany) as lyophilized culture and activated in the culture medium suggested by DSMZ.
